Rashi on Shabbat 21b:10:1.english: What is Hanukkah - For which miracle did they establish it?

Rashi on Shabbat 21b:10:2.hebrew: בחותמו - בהצנע וחתום בטבעתו, והכיר שלא נגעו בו:
Rashi on Shabbat 21b:10:2.english: With his seal - In concealment and sealed with his signet ring, and [so one] recognized that they had not touched it.

Rashi on Shabbat 21b:10:3.hebrew: ה"ג ועשאום ימים טובים בהלל והודאה - לא שאסורין במלאכה, שלא נקבעו אלא לקרות הלל ולומר על הנסים בהודאה:
Rashi on Shabbat 21b:10:3.english: This is the reading: "And they made them holidays with Hallel and thanksgiving" - Not that they are forbidden from [performing] work, for they were established only to recite Hallel and to say Al HaNissim in thanksgiving.

Rashi on Shabbat 21b:11:1.english: A spark - [This means] a spark (*estinceles*, Old French for sparks).

Rashi on Shabbat 21b:11:2.english: Hammer - A large sledgehammer of blacksmiths.

Rashi on Shabbat 21b:11:3.english: The owner of the camel is liable - For he should not have made his bundle so large that it would enter into the store.

Rashi on Shabbat 21b:12:1.hebrew: בנר חנוכה פטור - חנוני, שברשות פירסום מצוה הניחה שם:
Rashi on Shabbat 21b:12:1.english: In [the case of] a Hanukkah lamp, [he is] exempt - The storekeeper [is exempt], for he placed it there with the authorization of publicizing the mitzvah.

Rashi on Shabbat 21b:12:2.english: That is to say - [This refers to] that which is taught: "In the case of a Hanukkah lamp, he is exempt."

Rashi on Shabbat 21b:1:1.english: One is not bound to it - Therefore, on a weekday it is permitted.

Rashi on Shabbat 21b:1:2.hebrew: ואסור להשתמש לאורה - שיהא ניכר שהוא נר מצוה, וליכא למיחש להטייה:
Rashi on Shabbat 21b:1:2.english: And it is prohibited to use its light - So that it will be evident that it is a mitzvah lamp, and [therefore] there is no concern of tilting [it].

Rashi on Shabbat 21b:2:1.english: And he did not accept it - For he did not consider him [authoritative enough] to rely on his words.

Rashi on Shabbat 21b:2:2.hebrew: אי זכאי - אילו הייתי זוכה ללומדה, הייתי גורסה כששמעתיה ראשון:
Rashi on Shabbat 21b:2:2.english: Had I merited - Had I merited to learn it, I would have memorized it when I first heard it.

Rashi on Shabbat 21b:2:3.english: Learning of youth - It is retained more than that of old age.

Rashi on Shabbat 21b:3:1.hebrew: לשיעורה - שיהא בה שמן כשיעור הזה, ומיהו אם כבתה אין זקוק לה:
Rashi on Shabbat 21b:3:1.english: For its measure - That it should contain oil according to this measure; but nevertheless, if it goes out, he is not bound to attend to it.

Rashi on Shabbat 21b:4:1.hebrew: רגלא דתרמודאי - שם אומה. מלקטי עצים דקים, ומתעכבין בשוק עד שהולכים בני השוק לבתיהם משחשכה, ומבעירים בבתיהם אור, וכשצריכין לעצים, יוצאים וקונין מהן:
Rashi on Shabbat 21b:4:1.english: The foot of the Tarmodeans - The name of a nation. [They were] gatherers of thin wood, and they would linger in the marketplace until the people of the marketplace went to their homes after nightfall and kindled a light in their homes; and when they needed wood, they would go out and buy from them.

Rashi on Shabbat 21b:5:1.hebrew: נר איש וביתו - נר אחד בכל לילה, ואיש וכל בני ביתו סגי להו בנר אחד:
Rashi on Shabbat 21b:5:1.english: A lamp for a man and his household - One lamp each night, and for a man and all the members of his household, one lamp suffices for them.

Rashi on Shabbat 21b:5:2.hebrew: והמהדרין - אחר המצות, עושין נר אחד בכל לילה לכל אחד ואחד מבני הבית:
Rashi on Shabbat 21b:5:2.english: And those who are meticulous - [In pursuit] of the mitzvot, they make one lamp each night for each and every member of the household.

Rashi on Shabbat 21b:6:1.english: Corresponding to the incoming days - Those that are destined to come.

Rashi on Shabbat 21b:6:2.hebrew: ימים היוצאין - שיצאו כבר, וזה שהוא עומד בו נמנה עם היוצאין:
Rashi on Shabbat 21b:6:2.english: The outgoing days - [The days] that have already gone out, and this [day] in which he stands is counted with the outgoing [days].

Rashi on Shabbat 21b:6:3.english: The bulls of the Festival - They progressively decrease in the sacrifices of Parashat Pinchas.

Rashi on Shabbat 21b:6:4.english: One elevates in [matters of] sanctity and does not downgrade - We derive it from Scripture in Menachot, in the chapter "Shtei HaLechem" (Menachot 99a).

Rashi on Shabbat 21b:8:1.hebrew: מבחוץ - משום פרסומי ניסא. ולא ברה"ר, אלא בחצרו, שבתיהן היו פתוחין לחצר:
Rashi on Shabbat 21b:8:1.english: On the outside - In order to publicize the miracle. And not in the public domain, but rather in his courtyard, for their houses opened into the courtyard.

Rashi on Shabbat 21b:8:2.english: And if he lived in an upper story - For he has no place in his courtyard to place it there.

Rashi on Shabbat 21b:8:3.english: He places it - On the inside, opposite the window adjacent to the public domain.

Rashi on Shabbat 21b:8:4.hebrew: הסכנה - שהיה להם לפרסיים חוק ביום אידם, שלא יבעירו נר אלא בבית ע"ז שלהם, כדאמרינן בגיטין (פ"ב דף יז:):
Rashi on Shabbat 21b:8:4.english: [A time of] danger - For the Persians had a decree on their festival day that they should not kindle a lamp except in their house of idol worship, as we say in Gittin (chapter 2, folio 17b).

Rashi on Shabbat 21b:9:1.english: Another lamp - To make a distinction in the matter.

Rashi on Shabbat 21b:9:2.hebrew: ואי איכא מדורה - אש — לא צריך נר אחרת, לפי שמשתמש לאור המדורה, ויש היכרא שהנר של מצוה היא:
Rashi on Shabbat 21b:9:2.english: And if there is a bonfire - [Meaning,] a fire — he does not need another lamp, since he uses the light of the bonfire, and there is a conspicuous distinction that the lamp is for the mitzvah.

Rashi on Shabbat 21b:9:3.english: And if he is an important person - Who is not accustomed to using the light of the bonfire.

Rashi on Shabbat 21b:9:4.hebrew: צריך נר אחרת - דאי לא, לא הוי היכר:
Rashi on Shabbat 21b:9:4.english: [He] needs another lamp - For if not, there is no recognizable distinction.

Tosafot on Shabbat 21b:10:1.hebrew: שהיה מונח בחותמו של כ"ג - אם כבר גזרו על הנכרים להיות כזבים (נדה פ"ד דף לד.), צ"ל שהיה מונח בחותם בקרקע, שלא הסיטו הכלי:
Tosafot on Shabbat 21b:10:1.english: "That was placed with the seal of the High Priest" - If [the Sages] had already decreed that gentiles are like zavin (Niddah, chapter 4, 34a), it must be said that it was placed sealed in the ground, so that they did not move the vessel.

Tosafot on Shabbat 21b:3:1.hebrew: דאי לא אדליק מדליק - אבל מכאן ואילך עבר הזמן. אומר הר"י פורת: דיש ליזהר ולהדליק בלילה מיד, שלא יאחר יותר מדאי; ומ"מ אם איחר, ידליק מספק, דהא משני שינויי אחרינא. ולר"י נראה: דעתה אין לחוש מתי ידליק, דאנו אין לנו היכרא אלא לבני הבית, שהרי מדליקין מבפנים:
Tosafot on Shabbat 21b:3:1.english: "That if he did not light, he lights" - But from here on, the time has passed. Rabbeinu Yosef Porat says that one must be careful to light immediately at night so that he does not delay excessively; and nonetheless, if he delayed, he should light out of doubt, for [the Gemara] offers another answer. And it appears to the Ri that nowadays, there is no concern as to when one lights, for we have no [public] recognition except for the members of the household, since we light indoors.

Tosafot on Shabbat 21b:5:1.hebrew: והמהדרין מן המהדרין - נראה לר"י, דב"ש וב"ה לא קיימי אלא אנר איש וביתו, שכן יש יותר הידור — דאיכא היכרא כשמוסיף והולך או מחסר, שהוא כנגד ימים הנכנסים או היוצאים. אבל אם עושה נר לכל אחד, אפי' יוסיף מכאן ואילך, ליכא היכרא, שיסברו שכך יש בני אדם בבית:
Tosafot on Shabbat 21b:5:1.english: "And the mehadrin min hamehadrin" - It appears to the Ri that Beit Shammai and Beit Hillel refer only to "a light for a person and his household," for in this way there is greater embellishment, as there is a recognizable indication when one progressively increases or decreases that it corresponds to the incoming or outgoing days. However, if one kindles a light for each person, even if he adds from then on, there is no recognizable indication, as [onlookers] will assume that this is how many people are in the house.

Tosafot on Shabbat 21b:8:1.hebrew: מצוה להניחה על פתח ביתו מבחוץ - ומיירי דליכא חצר, אלא בית עומד סמוך לרה"ר. אבל אם יש חצר לפני הבית, מצוה להניח על פתח חצר; דאמר לקמן: "חצר שיש לה ב' פתחים צריכה ב' נרות", ואמרי' נמי: "נר שיש לה שני פיות עולה לשני בני אדם" — משמע לשני בתים; ואם היו מניחים על פתחי בתיהם, היה לזה מימין ולזה משמאל, אבל אי מניחים על פתח החצר — אתי שפיר:
Tosafot on Shabbat 21b:8:1.english: It is a mitzvah to place it at the entrance to one's house on the outside - And [this] is dealing with [a case where] there is no courtyard, but rather the house stands adjacent to the public domain. However, if there is a courtyard in front of the house, it is a mitzvah to place [it] at the entrance of the courtyard; for [the Gemara] says below (23a): "A courtyard that has two entrances requires two lamps." And we also say [below, 23b]: "A lamp that has two spouts counts for two people" — which implies [people of] two houses; and if they were to place [it] at the entrances of their houses, it would be on the right for this one and on the left for that one, but if they place [it] at the entrance of the courtyard, it works out well.

Tosafot on Shabbat 21b:8:2.hebrew: ובשעת הסכנה - נראה לר"י דהיינו מכי אתו חברי לבבל, כדאמר בפ' כירה (לקמן שבת דף מה. ושם): מהו לטלטל שרגא דחנוכתא מקמי חברי בשבתא. וא"ת: דעל השלחן נמי יקחו אותו, כדאמר בגיטין (דף יז.): רבה בר בר חנה חלש, אתא חברא שקל שרגא מקמייהו? וי"ל: דאין רגילות כ"כ לחפש בבתים:
Tosafot on Shabbat 21b:8:2.english: And in a time of danger - It appears to the Ri that this refers to [the time] when the chavrei [Persian fire-priests] came to Babylonia, as [the Gemara] says in the chapter Kirah (below, Shabbat 45a, and see there): "What is [the ruling regarding] moving a Hanukkah lamp from before the chavrei on Shabbat?" And if you say that even on the table they would take it, as [the Gemara] says in Gittin (17a): "Rabbah bar bar Chana was ill; a chavara came and took the lamp from before them"? And one can say that it is not so common [for them] to search inside houses.
